incidents.body:
UKMTO ADVISORY 098-26 - UKMTO has received a report of suspicious activity. The Master of a tanker has reported hearing an explosion whilst transiting in the southern Red Sea.
The report confirms that crew and vessel are safe. No environmental damage has been reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ADVISORY 096-26 - UKMTO have received a report of an incident involving a tanker and military forces in the Gulf of Oman.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment. Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY 097-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the southern Red Sea.
It has been reported to UKMTO that a tanker witnessed a splash from an unknown
projectile in close proximity to the vessel. Reports confirm that the vessel and crew
are safe. Environmental impact is unconfirmed at present.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO while authorities continue to investigate

UKMTO ATTACK 095-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 70NM southwest of AL SHUQAIQ, Saudi Arabia. The Master of a tanker reports being struck by an unknown projectile which has caused a fire
onboard that the crew are currently fighting. There are no reported casualties and no environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO ATTACK 094-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM northeast of LIMAH, OMAN
UKMTO has received multiple reports that a tanker is reporting over VHF Channel 16
that it has been struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
UPDATE 001: The CSO of the tanker has reported to UKMTO that the crew have abandoned the
vessel and are currently embarked in a lifeboat.
No environmental impact has been reported.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO ATTACK 092-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM northwest of Kumzar, Oman.
UKMTO have received information from military authorities that a vessel is on fire. The cause of
the fire has not been verified as this time.
Update – 001 UKMTO has reclassified as an Attack. The CSO has confirmed the vessel was struck
by an unknown projectile. The crew safely abandoned the vessel and have been recovered by a
tug boat. The fire has not been extinguished and the vessel is currently adrift. There is no
reported environmental impact.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO while authorities investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 093-26 - ATTACK
Report Date:19 Jul 2026
Report Time: 2230UTC
Issue Date:20 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 17NM east of Dibba, United Arab Emirates.
The Master of a vessel reports being struck by an unknown projectile causing damage to the
steering gear. All the crew are reported as safe. There is no environmental impact.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO

UKMTO ADVISORY 091 -26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a merchant vessel and military
forces approximately 100NM east of Duqm, Oman.
Reports indicate that the tanker was subject to interaction as part of ongoing
military activity in the region.
Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.

UKMTO ADVISORY 089-26. Report Date: 15 Jul 2026
Issue Date: 17 Jul 2026
Source: Military authorities
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a merchant vessel and military
forces in the Arabian Gulf.
Reports indicate that the tanker was subject to interactions as part of ongoing
military activity in the region.
Authorities are aware and relevant investigations remain ongoing.
Vessels are advised to consider the latest maritime security information and
maintain awareness of the evolving operational environment.

UKMTO HIJACK 090-26 - UKMTO has received a report of an incident 65NM south of Al Mukalla, Yemen.
Military authorities have reported that the vessel was boarded by unauthorised
personnel whilst transiting east in the Gulf of Aden.
Authorities are investigating.
UPDATE 001 – Military authorities have reported to UKMTO that the vessel involved has
been maneuvered into Somalian territorial waters. UKMTO has re-classified this incident
as Hijack

UKMTO WARNING 088-26. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 19NM east of Khasab, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile causing minor structural
damage to the port side.
All crew are safe and accounted for, no environmental impact has been reported and
the vessel is continuing to its next port of call.
Authorities are investigating.

UKMTO WARNING 087-26
Incident Date: 13 Jul 2026 Incident Time: TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM southeast of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by a missile while transiting outbound on the southern route.

UKMTO WARNING 086-26
Incident Date: 13 Jul 2026 Incident Time:TBC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 13NM southeast of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by a missile while transiting outbound on the southern route.

UKMTO WARNING 085-26 - ATTACK
Report Date: 13 Jul 2026
Report Time: 2104 UTC
Issue Date: 13 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 40NM northeast of Qalhat, Oman.
The Master of a Tanker reports being hit by an unknown projectile on the starboard side engine
room. All crew are safe and accounted for with no environmental impact reported.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
Authorities continue to investigate.

UKMTO WARNING 084-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY
Report Date:13 Jul 2026 Report Time:1019UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 50NM south of Aden, Yemen.
A tanker travelling east in the IRTC has reported being approached by 6 small boats
approaching from the starboard side. One small boat has closed to 5 cables and the
AST on board the tanker has fired warning shots. The other 5 small boats have
remained at 1NM.

UKMTO has received a report of an incident 9NM east of Oman.
Military authorities have reported that a container ship has sustained damage to the rear of the vessel which has caused a fire onboard.
Authorities are investigating.
UPDATE 001: UKMTO has been informed by military authorities and the CSO of the vessel that the crew have abandoned the vessel and are currently embarked in a lifeboat.
UPDATE 002: UKMTO has spoken to the CSO of the container ship who confirms that the crew has been rescued by local authorities.
Authorities continue to investigate.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO\_WARNING\_82-26. UKMTO has received a report of a further incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz.
The tanker was struck by an unknown Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) and has sustained minor structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported, and vessel is continuing to its next port of call.
UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO\_WARNING\_81-26.
UKMTO has received a report of an incident involving a tanker transiting the Strait of
Hormuz. The tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile and is believed to have
structural damage. No casualties or environmental impact reported.
UKMTO continues to investigate. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 080-26 - ATTACK
Report Date: 06 Jul 2026 Report Time: 2119UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM east of Limah, Oman.
A tanker has reported being hit by an unknown projectile on the port side causing a
fire, whilst travelling southbound.
No casualties or environmental impact reported.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 079-26 ATTACK
Report Date: 05 Jul 2026 Report Time: 0719UTC
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 30NM southwest of Al Hudaydah, Yemen.
A cargo vessel has triggered a distress alert stating that they are under attack by unknown armed assailants.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.

UKMTO WARNING 078-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY
Report Date: 01 Jul 2026
Report Time:0945UTC
Issue Date: 01 Jul 2026
Source: Master
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 85NM south of Balhaf, Yemen.
The Master of a tanker had reported a small craft approached the vessel on the port
quarter at 2NM.
The small craft was described as having a low freeboard and orange interior with 4
POB. The small craft has now left the vicinity proceeding south. The crew are
reported as safe and the vessel is continuing on its voyage.
Authorities are investigating.
Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to
UKMTO.
- ### Illegal Boarding UKMTO #77
UKMTO WARNING 077-26 - ILLEGAL BOARDING
Report Date:01 Jul 2026
Report Time: 0715UTC
Issue Date:01 Jul 2026
Source: Company Security Officer
UKMTO has received a report of an incident 76NM south of BALHAF, YEMEN.
The CSO reports a vessel being approached by small craft with several POB
bearing small arms.
The Crew are mustered in the citadel and are reported as safe. The Master of a thirdparty vessel in the vicinity, reported small arms fired over Ch 16, this remains
unconfirmed.
